text: Portrait step body layout: primary is the 4:5 box at 49 characters per line and line height 1.55 (about 17.9px type on an iPhone; about 15 lines fit). Fallback D, used if adjusting the steps runs into trouble: 54 characters x 17 lines at 1.55 in the same 4:5 box (about 16.5px type). A 3:4 box is rejected because it does not use the space an iPhone gives the step body.
